problem.title: The Living Market
problem.summary: Watch a closed economy discover its only public price. Production, real needs, beliefs, liquidity, speculation, and internal arbitrage move an exact constant-product AMM with no oracle or outside market.

instances.label: Micro
instances.description: A compact closed market that exposes every reserve calculation and refusal

instances.label: Showcase
instances.description: Eight heterogeneous actors discover value through production, consumption, liquidity, information, and exchange

instances.label: Stress
instances.description: A four-times-deeper economy with proportionally larger flows and the same exact replay guarantees

strategies.label: Endogenous market day
strategies.description: The complete closed-economy price-discovery story, including a demand shock and supply response.

strategies.label: Counterfactual: no whale
strategies.description: Replay the same economy without its largest buyer and inspect the causal price difference.

strategies.label: Counterfactual: thin liquidity
strategies.description: Withdraw half the founding liquidity before trading and observe amplified price impact.

instance.label: Showcase
instance.description: Eight heterogeneous actors discover value through production, consumption, liquidity, information, and exchange

documents.title: Living Market · endogenous price discovery
documents.description: A founding price hypothesis meets production, real consumption, informed speculation, a demand whale, adaptive liquidity, and internal arbitrage. No external price exists.
